notes.title: Version 1.10 Update Notice
notes.notes: [p]Dear players, it's been a while! The newly updated Version 1.10 introduces a brand-new ending: What happens when Nyaruru successfully convinces Professor Sakura?[/p][p]To trigger this ending, you must find Professor Sakura in the new map before entering Theia's bedroom. If you've already entered Theia's room, the worldline will have converged, making this new ending inaccessible.[/p][p][i]In the new ending, make sure to keep everyone alive![/i][/p][p]Every boss has their own weaknesses - make full use of Nyaruru's various abilities to exploit them in battle![/p]

notes.title: Merchandise News & 1.10a Update Preview!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am WhiteCatToru（赤瞳大白猫） the game producer. In the current version, no matter which ending the story goes, Professor Sakura always believes that there must be a new 'vessel' to replace the old one. I believe you must be curious about what would happen if Nyaruru changes Sakura's mind before all that happens.

This possibility inspired me to develop following version, and it drives me to create the new map, new Boss, and new ending, where Professor Sakura will lead everyone to the final fight against the unsealed Plague Witch. This time, Nyaruru will not fight alone. Enjoy this glorious battle that requires everyone's effort to win!

notes.title: 1.03a Version Update Announcement
notes.notes:
After completing Ending 3 and returning to the town, players can now choose Lily as their character. 
Nyakori may survive in Ending 3 now. 
More dialogues with Sakura on the second and third days and Lily's inner monologue in the labyrinth have been added. 

We hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Announcement: Version 1.02c - Story Optimizations
notes.notes:
This update includes the following changes:

1. The story has been remade. Due to the change in the storyline, save files of players currently challenging the final boss or those who have completed the game will automatically roll back to the state before challenging the final boss. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and encourage everyone to experience the new ending.
2. After completing Ending 3, players can return to the town and continue exploring.
3. The difficulty of the bosses Theia, Yuri, Nyakori, and the Plague Witch has been reduced, especially in Easy mode.
4. The Boss Challenge Room now includes all the bosses available in the game.
5. Some achievements that were no longer achievable due to the story remake have been removed.
Thank you for your understanding and we hope you enjoy the improved gameplay experience.

notes.title: The plan to release the game's final version today has been canceled.
notes.notes:
Due to significant feedback from players regarding the story ending, we have decided to spend an additional half month improving the existing endings.

PS: Lily will join the final battle with the witch.

After completing the ending, players will no longer enter the boss challenge room and will instead return to the town after the events are resolved (assuming Nyaruru survives and completes the game).

notes.title: Nyaruru Fishy Fight full version will be released on May 22nd.
notes.notes: Thank you for your patience. Although it took much longer than expected, we have completed the development of all new content and are currently in the testing and polishing stage. We apologize for the long wait. As compensation for the delay, we have added an extra BOSS, bringing the total to 15 (promised 14).

notes.title: Update: v0.92e
notes.notes:
Fix the bug of false report by Windows Defender antivirus software.

Fix the bug of BGM loading error by chance for computers with slow hard disk reading speed.

notes.title: Update: New Map - The Sea of Stars
notes.notes:
The zero-gravity area [The Sea of Stars] has been updated! Nyaruru will not fall under the influence of gravity in this area. But don't worry about her mobility. Making good use of the upward dash and the dive attack will let Nyaruru move flexibly on the Y axis.
